D7 scope: the key goes only to the first-party default endpoint (provider_id None, OpenAi flavor, default base). Azure and UnifiedAzureAi stay off until staging verifies acceptance. Lead to confirm.

The named tests check the body that request_body builds, which is what post_chat sends. They do not check the HTTP send, because wiremock cannot reach the first-party default base. The wire path is covered only by construction.
The key crosses gRPC on ZDR requests too (a hash of ids). The adapter's !req.zdr check is the only guard that keeps it out of provider bodies, so that check must not be removed or moved.
